title: Validate planning values
responsibility: Validate identity, contract and author fields and normalize image rectangles.

inputs.name: text.value
inputs.description: Nonblank string of at most one million characters.

inputs.name: slug.value
inputs.description: Lowercase kebab-case name starting with a letter, at most 64 characters.

inputs.name: planValidate.unitId
inputs.description: Supported category and slug joined by a dot.

inputs.name: contractHash.contract
inputs.description: Contract with nonblank responsibility, named/typed input and output arrays, unique nonblank error/state/viewport lists and supported viewport names.

inputs.name: author.value
inputs.description: Person or agent author with a nonblank name.

inputs.name: region.value
inputs.description: Null or a finite positive rectangle contained within normalized image coordinates from zero to one.

inputs.name: filename.value
inputs.description: Lowercase artifact filename using letters, digits, dots and hyphens, beginning with a letter/digit and containing no double dot.

inputs.name: version.value
inputs.description: Design version string beginning with v followed by at least three digits.

outputs.name: categories
outputs.description: Mapping from supported singular categories to folder names.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: Returns nothing after validating text; does not trim the value.

outputs.name: slug
outputs.description: Returns nothing after validating the slug.

outputs.name: contractHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the validated, consistently serialized contract.

outputs.name: author
outputs.description: Returns nothing after validating author kind and name.

outputs.name: region
outputs.description: Null or rectangle coordinates rounded to six decimal places.

outputs.name: filename
outputs.description: Returns nothing after validating the filename.

outputs.name: version
outputs.description: Returns nothing after validating the version syntax.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: invalid-input for rejected values, unsafe-path for a filename, or invalid-region for an invalid rectangle.
